name: step to the minimum of the local quadratic model
mechanism: approximate the objective near the current point by a quadratic from its gradient and curvature and jump to that quadratic's minimum, repeating

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Newton's method in optimization' in section Computational mathematics / Optimization algorithms:
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'BFGS method': a nonlinear optimization algorithm
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Gauss–Newton algorithm': an algorithm for solving nonlinear least squares problems
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Levenberg–Marquardt algorithm': an algorithm for solving nonlinear least squares problems

requires: second derivatives (or an approximation built from gradient differences)
fails_when: indefinite curvature steps to a saddle or maximum
cubic cost per step in dimension
